details.effect: [quick] Select up to 2 enemy followers on the field and destroy them.

issues: The spell effect is encoded as banishUpTo 2 enemy followers, but the source says to destroy up to 2 enemy followers. Change the effect to destroy up to 2 enemy followers instead of banishing them.

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: Select an [abysscraft] follower on your field. Give it [attack]+1 and, if there are 0 cards in your hand, give it Storm.

issues: The spell targets are encoded incorrectly as selfFollower, which means a follower on your own field matching the selector type rather than the selected ally target generally intended for this spell. The same selected Abysscraft follower should receive both the +1 attack and possible Storm; encode the effect so one chosen ally Abysscraft follower on your field is targeted for both clauses.

The +1 buff is incomplete: the source says "Give it [attack]+1" to the selected Abysscraft follower, but parsed does not clearly preserve the single shared target across both clauses. Use one selected target and apply both effects to that same target.

The Storm clause should apply to the same selected follower if your hand has 0 cards. Parsed re-selects a selfFollower independently; change it so the conditional grantKeyword applies to the originally selected target.

details.effect: [fanfare] Search your deck for a 3-cost follower and 1-cost follower, summon them, then shuffle your deck. Whenever another iM@S CG follower is put onto your field, select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 2 damage.

issues: The fanfare search is too broad: the source requires exactly a 3-cost follower and a 1-cost follower, but parsed uses maxCost 3 and maxCost 1. Change the first tutor filter to a follower with cost exactly 3 and the second to a follower with cost exactly 1.

The triggered ability should be "Whenever another iM@S CG follower is put onto your field," but parsed triggers on any iM@S CG follower entering and does not exclude this card itself. Add exclusion so only another iM@S CG follower entering your field triggers the damage ability.

details.effect: Select an enemy follower on the field. Combo (3) - Deal it 2 damage.

issues: The Combo (3) condition is missing. The source says "Select an enemy follower on the field. Combo (3) - Deal it 2 damage," so the damage should be gated by condition combo count 3 rather than always happening.
